title: Unit 27 Consolidation: Southern Cone dictatorships
goal: Review the unit on the Southern Cone dictatorships: Chile, Argentina, Uruguay, Operation Condor and the memory of the dictatorships.
grammar: consolidation of dictatorship, repression, coordination, memory and democracy

items: I can use se with a verb to say what was done under a dictatorship.
I can contrast the preterite and the imperfect to tell what happened in Argentina.
I can use superlatives to describe Uruguay and give the source of a judgement.
I can use cuyo to say whose aim, campaign or discovery I mean.
I can use a pesar de to say what happened despite an obstacle.
